GOV-F-004-S120.title: Audit Query & Retrieval API
GOV-F-004-S120.description: Implement secure backend API endpoints to query audit logs by trace_id, actor, date range, and action_type with pagination and access controls. Ensure read-only access with no mutation capability.
GOV-F-004-S120.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (read-only query patterns, auth controls); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S121.title: Audit Integrity & Immutability Tests
GOV-F-004-S121.description: Develop unit and integration tests to validate append-only behavior, hash chain integrity, rejection of update/delete operations, and consistency under concurrent writes.
GOV-F-004-S121.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_debug_logger.py (logging validation patterns); Code/DataPipelines/tests/test_gpt_reader_integration.py (audit + read validation); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S122.title: Cross-Service Integration with Existing Logging Systems
GOV-F-004-S122.description: Integrate append-only audit logging with existing debug_logger, safety_service emergency audit trails, and GPTReader audit flows to ensure unified audit coverage across GPT and Claude operations.
GOV-F-004-S122.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (existing logging); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/shared/safety/safety_service.py (emergency audit trail); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (audit logging); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004
